intro: Every word this module's exercises use, on one deck of flashcards: 266 cards, 122 of them nouns. The vocabulary of this module is work, study, media and opinions, and the verbs and connectors you need to argue a point, from the themes Arbeit & Beruf, Bildung & Studium, Beziehungen & Meinungen, Wohnen. Write the German, choose it from four options, or flip the card and rate yourself. A word you miss comes back later in the same run, and stays in your weak words until you get it right three times in a row.
tips[0].title: Nouns come with their plural
tips[0].text: The plural now matters as much as the article, because you write longer texts. Read the plural on the back of every noun card, and notice the pattern it follows.
tips[0].check.why: The plural note -n tells you to add -n: die Kollegen.
tips[1].title: Job words come in families
tips[1].text: Most work words grow from a handful of stems: die Arbeit, der Arbeitgeber, der Arbeitnehmer, arbeitslos; sich bewerben, die Bewerbung, der Bewerber.
tips[1].check.why: der Arbeitgeber gives (geben) the work; der Arbeitnehmer takes (nehmen) it.
tips[2].title: Adjectives as people keep their endings
tips[2].text: der Angestellte, ein Angestellter, die Angestellten: a person named by an adjective changes its ending like an adjective.
tips[2].check.why: No article and a woman: Angestellte, like eine alte.
remember[0]: Never say a noun without its article, not even in your head.
remember[1]: Miss a word? It comes back in the same run. Three correct answers in a row take it off the weak list.
remember[2]: Verbs and adjectives have no article: type them as they stand, like "arbeitslos".
hook: Work, study, flats and opinions: the words you need to apply for a job or argue a point, each noun with its plural.
